text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I need to
check my part-time shift schedule.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I have quite a few gaps in my schedule around here.
I could fit in some one-off part-time gigs... but..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "If I squeeze in a part-time shift here, I might not have time to rest my body."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I want to be able to stay energetic
without having to take breaks...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin seems to have lingering fatigue
from her races. We might need to rethink
her upcoming race schedule.
